mapper.select: SELECT blacklist.id, blacklist.black_name, blacklist.black_mobile_phone_hash, blacklist.black_birth_date, blacklist.black_reason, blacklist.black_mode, blacklist.active_yn, blacklist.created_by, blacklist.created_at, blacklist.updated_at, blacklist.expires_at, COUNT(match_log.id) AS match_count FROM admin_blacklist blacklist LEFT JOIN admin_blacklist_match_log match_log ON match_log.blacklist_id = blacklist.id WHERE blacklist.id = #{id} GROUP BY blacklist.id, blacklist.black_name, blacklist.black_mobile_phone_hash, blacklist.black_birth_date, blacklist.black_reason, blacklist.black_mode, blacklist.active_yn, blacklist.created_by, blacklist.created_at, blacklist.updated_at, blacklist.expires_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_blacklist ( black_name, black_mobile_phone_hash, black_birth_date, black_reason, black_mode, active_yn, created_by, created_at, updated_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{blackName}, #{blackMobilePhoneHash}, #{blackBirthDate}, #{blackReason}, #{blackMode}, #{activeYn}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_blacklist SET black_name = #{blackName}, black_mobile_phone_hash = #{blackMobilePhoneHash}, black_birth_date = #{blackBirthDate}, black_reason = #{blackReason}, black_mode = #{blackMode}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT blacklist.id, blacklist.black_name, blacklist.black_mobile_phone_hash, blacklist.black_birth_date, blacklist.black_reason, blacklist.black_mode, blacklist.active_yn, blacklist.created_by, blacklist.created_at, blacklist.updated_at, blacklist.expires_at, COUNT(match_log.id) AS match_count FROM admin_blacklist blacklist LEFT JOIN admin_blacklist_match_log match_log ON match_log.blacklist_id = blacklist.id WHERE blacklist.active_yn = 'Y' AND blacklist.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND blacklist.expires_at <= #{expiresAt} GROUP BY blacklist.id, blacklist.black_name, blacklist.black_mobile_phone_hash, blacklist.black_birth_date, blacklist.black_reason, blacklist.black_mode, blacklist.active_yn, blacklist.created_by, blacklist.created_at, blacklist.updated_at, blacklist.expires_at ORDER BY blacklist.expires_at ASC, blacklist.id ASC
